summary: Guard holds need a SuperAdmin, AD sync never removes on a doubt, and AD clean-up can be approved in batches.

new.title: SuperAdmin approves guard holds
new.text: Changes held by a guard now need a SuperAdmin's approval, with counts on the Guards page.

new.title: Approve AD clean-up in batches
new.text: AD clean-up and server groups can now be approved in batches.

new.title: List menu and two protection switches
new.text: Every list has a list menu, and Settings has two new protection switches.

fixes.title: AD sync never removes on a doubt
fixes.text: When AD sync is not sure, it removes nothing.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Clear group states with one remove or delete dialog, revoking by scope and level, a settings clean-up, and a retry after a create.
